Limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the driver's own telemetry, not on his assertion.

The trip_record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 18:06:05 and the trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at the same 18:06:05 — the arrival marker is corroborated by GPS rather than contradicted by it, so POL-NS-05's false-arrival triggers (over 300 m from the pin, or 15 km/h or above at the marker) are not engaged. The driver's minimum recorded distance to the pin is 0.16 m.

The trip was terminated by the driver at 18:12:48 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three reason codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, and the record shows no boarding event and no started_at. Limb (d) is therefore satisfied on the face of the trip record.

The driver did not simply wait in silence: he sent an in-app message at 18:06:25 reading 'im at the pickup point', delivered at 18:06:26 and read by the rider at 18:06:55. The rider never replied, and the driver then waited a further six minutes before cancelling. This is coordination by the driver, not abandonment of the pickup.

The rider's own track is present and shows her device stationary at a mean distance of 787.7 m from the pickup pin throughout the window, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius for STANDARD. Whatever the rider's explanation, she was not at the pin, and POL-NS-04 limb (c) cannot exonerate her on this record.

The rider's claim is that she 'never saw the car'. The trace shows the car held position at the pin for 400 seconds with 41 qualifying fixes and the driver messaged her at the pin. The claim is contradicted by the rider's own device data, which places her roughly 788 m away.

The fare ledger shows a single cancellation_fee line of SGD 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. That figure reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50 carried on the trip record, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and the amount charged is the amount the policy in force authorises.

POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force — SGD 3.60 — the residual 20 percent being the platform service fee. Both limbs must hold for compensation to be withheld; neither does. Compensation is therefore payable and the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, not NO_ACTION.

No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 is engaged. The two admissible artifacts agree rather than contradict on arrival and dwell; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, so limb (c) and limb (d) do not fire; and the deciding facts — arrival and dwell — rest on a COMPLETE, weight-1.0 GPS trace, so limb (e) does not fire either.

The traffic advisory artifact is MISSING — no advisory covers Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 in this window — and I do not rely on it. ruling.explanation:
Both parties agree on the arithmetic, and the record supports it. The driver's GPS trace (EV-GPS-02745, weight 1.0) places him inside the pickup geofence continuously from 18:06:05 to 18:12:45 — a single unbroken qualifying run of 400 seconds, 41 consecutive in-radius fixes, against the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). POL-NS-01 limb (c) is therefore satisfied on the driver's own telemetry. His arrival tap at 18:06:05 (EV-TRIP-02745) coincides exactly with the first qualifying geofence fix (dwell start offset 0.0 s), so POL-NS-05's false-arrival triggers are not engaged — he was not more than 300 m out and not moving at 15 km/h or above — and the waiting clock is not recomputed. The trip was terminated by the driver at 18:12:48 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, with no boarding event and no started_at, and the cancellation fell well after the required dwell elapsed at 18:09:05. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them: POL-NS-03 does not apply because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, and POL-NS-06 does not apply because the 400-second dwell exceeds the 180-second minimum without any accumulation. The fare ledger line of SGD 4.50 reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and no clock-skew, gap or chat defect either.

The rider's claim 'I never saw the car' is not supported. Her own device track (EV-GPS-02745) places her 784 to 790 metres from the pickup pin throughout the window — min 784.4 m, max 790.5 m, mean 787.7 m — with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius. The driver also sent 'im at the pickup point' at 18:06:25, which she read at 18:06:55, and then waited a further six minutes. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate her because limb (a) fails: the only message in the chat log was sent by the driver, not by the rider, and she sent no locating or coordinating message and placed no in-app call. POL-NS-11 changes nothing, because the rider track is present and readable — limb (c) is affirmatively failed on admissible fixes, not undecidable.

Compensation. POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force, SGD 3.60, the residual 20 percent being the platform service fee. The anti-farming check on EV-DPROF-02745 does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by completed_trips_30d of 132 is 0.0076, below the 0.08 rate limb; both limbs are required to withhold and neither holds. No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger fires — the GPS trace and trip record agree rather than contradict on arrival and dwell, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, the anti-farming check is clear, and the deciding facts rest on a COMPLETE weight-1.0 trace. POL-NS-10 has no application: the rider did not cancel; the driver did, under the no-show code. The two claims about the MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02745-01, weight 0.0) were discarded at the mechanical stage for not naming the impairment code, and nothing turns on the advisory, since the driver's dwell is a single unbroken run needing no POL-NS-06(i) accumulation.

Confidence is 0.95, within the cap of 1.0 set by the artifacts that carry the deciding facts (EV-GPS-02745 and EV-TRIP-02745, both weight 1.0); no deciding artifact is impaired. The monetary effect of SGD 3.60 does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically. No clause produces a referral.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
